_readme: Kit v2 config. Read by .claude/hooks/*.ps1, .claude/scripts/*.ps1, the skills, and the agents. Run /customize-kit to fill it in. Empty values disable the related feature. Commands run from the project (or worktree) root via 'cmd.exe /c'. Placeholders: {file} = edited file (verify.fast), {tests} = space-separated test files (testAudit.run), {port} = per-task dev-server port (ui.*).

ui.startCommand: set "API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:1{port}" && pnpm exec concurrently -k -n web,api "pnpm --dir web dev --port {port}" "uv --directory python run uvicorn api.main:app --reload --reload-dir api/src --port 1{port}"
